records.synonyms_note: Ascyrum hypericoides L. is a homotypic synonym. POWO accepts three subspecies: hypericoides, multicaule, prostratum.
records.duplicate_caution: Keep species-level learner; do not assign a subspecies or confuse with separate H. crux-andreae.
records.handoff: Taxonomy-only evidence; no range decision or other lane edits.
